prompt_set.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Make a game runtime PNG master at EXACTLY 1024x1536 portrait with genuine transparent RGBA background. The input is the latest approved character review sheet, an EDIT TARGET: isolate/reconstruct ONLY the LEFTMOST FULLY DRESSED FRONT character at high resolution, not the underlayer character and not rear views. Preserve the approved face, body proportions, hairstyle, costume construction, colors, materials and all equipment. This is a faithful single-character export, NOT a redesign. Entire head, hair ends, feet, all weapons, equipment and gown hems inside canvas, with about 30-50 px safe margin. Body axis centered, narrow balanced game-readable silhouette, natural frontal or slight 3/4 frontal pose. Keep original illustrated rendering, sharp face and material fidelity. ONE character only, no text, no labels, no frames, no review panels, no swatches, no paper, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no matte, no background objects. Retain transparency in gaps. Ardella v3: white/silver metallic plate armor, white fur shoulders, blue cloak and waist cloth, silver braided hair and blue eyes, restrained silver detailing. Sword held physically correctly by the grip, complete sword blade and point visible directed down, large silver kite shield with blue emblem fully visible. No new gold decoration. Recenter the original figure so the shield and sword both fit.
